coverage_gaps: Layer 1B input was truncated, so this Layer 1C universe may omit node-level candidates from assessment, campus software, school operations, Indian education, Brazilian education, and European training nodes.
Need current market-cap, liquidity, revenue-growth, margin, leverage, short-interest, and valuation checks before any Layer 2 prioritization.

Need official verification of 2026 U.S. student-loan, Workforce Pell, graduate borrowing, gainful-employment, and low-earnings-accountability rules using Department of Education, Federal Register, and Congressional sources.
Need fuller public-company mapping for India education assets, including exchange tickers and liquidity, because this pass is U.S.- and ADR-heavy.
Need current China education policy verification before assigning high confidence to EDU, TAL, or GOTU.
Need private-company mapping because several likely chokepoints are not public or are private-equity owned, including major LMS, assessment integrity, OPM, SIS, and K-12 infrastructure assets.
Need distinction between companies that sell content and companies that control workflow, identity, assessment, student finance, credentialing, or outcomes data.
Need evidence of paid-budget demand by occupation: AI/data/cyber/cloud, healthcare, skilled trades, teaching, and compliance-heavy roles may have very different demand durability.
Need explicit buyer-channel split for each candidate: consumer-paid, employer-paid, district/state-funded, university-funded, federal-aid-supported, or student-financed.
Need falsification plans for AI deflation risk in generic course content, tutoring, homework-help, and low-differentiation test-prep models.

memory_update.text: Education Layer 1 universe should be ranked by chokepoint proximity rather than education-brand fame: enterprise distribution, workflow integration, regulated credentialing, assessment, outcomes data, and financing infrastructure are higher-quality nodes than generic content.

COUR and DCBO are the cleanest public pure-play mappings in the initial education universe: COUR for combined skills-content and enterprise distribution after the Udemy combination, DCBO for LMS/LXP infrastructure and recurring enterprise learning workflows.

WDAY, SAP, MSFT, and ADP are less pure education names but may control stronger enterprise chokepoints through HCM, skills taxonomies, professional identity data, compliance records, productivity workflows, and HR/payroll distribution.
Regulated healthcare education and career pathways deserve separate validation because healthcare workforce shortages may create more durable paid training budgets than generic consumer learning.

Need to rebuild the international universe with current tickers, market caps, liquidity, and country-policy checks for India, China, Brazil, Europe, and Australia before concluding the Layer 1 universe is complete.

Need current official-policy verification on U.S. student-loan, Workforce Pell, gainful-employment, and low-earnings-accountability rules before assigning high confidence to student-finance and federal-aid-supported higher-ed candidates.

summary: Merged Layer 1 education universe across employer-paid workforce upskilling, learning infrastructure, credential/outcomes compliance, K-12 virtual and career pathways, higher-ed/OPM assets, assessment, student finance, and international education platforms. Initial Serenity ranking favors companies closer to durable chokepoints: enterprise distribution, HR/workflow integration, skills taxonomies, regulated credential pathways, learning records/compliance, outcomes data, and financing rails. This is not a validated investable list; it is a Layer 1 research universe for later evidence, valuation, and falsification checks.
universe_method: multi-step: theme decomposition -> node expansion -> dedupe/rank
